top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Hong Kong Cyclothon's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
Hong Kong Cyclothon's flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 31 miles.
When someone attacks on flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
31 miles on flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Hong Kong Cyclothon, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Hong Kong Cyclothon's flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
2-minute all-out efforts on flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
At Hong Kong Cyclothon, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Hong Kong Cyclothon. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Hong Kong Cyclothon's flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network actually does to you.
Torque for headwinds and flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network. When cadence drops below 70rpm, muscular strength keeps the watts up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Standard hydration and fueling. One bottle per hour minimum. Gel or bar every 45 minutes at race intensity.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Hong Kong Cyclothon requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 31 miles of flat urban highway, bridge, and tunnel network in Tsim Sha Tsui East, Kowloon, Hong Kong.
